sources.role: processed observations, operating inputs and historical simulations
parameter values, units interpreted through paper equations, source search bounds

provenance.sharing_conditions: Publicly accessible article and associated data repository. Article is CC BY 4.0; no separate software/data license was found in the source repository root. Public access alone is not a blanket relicensing grant. Published figures and upstream code are not redistributed here.

transformations.operation: source OD600 multiplied by 0.37 gDW/L per OD unit; processed values already contain this conversion; do not apply twice
select existing reference measurements; convert declared sample hours to seconds via 3600 s/h; preserve values and per-field sample order; omit missing samples as the existing adapter requires

uncertainty.meaning: No measurement covariance or statistically justified standard deviations are supplied to this forward adapter. Source fit weights and source measurement_error settings are not reinterpreted as inverse covariance. See source variable records for the original estimation settings.

provenance.parameter_origin: Published/source-configured coefficients reused without fitting in PharmaPy; source bounds are provenance, not new runtime constraints.
